konu: Theme 2: Friendship / Music Preferences (Making Suggestions & Expressing Preferences)
ciktilar: Students will be able to make suggestions and state personal preferences using 'prefer' and 'would rather'.
Students will be able to give reasons for their choices using 'because', 'since', and 'as'.
Students will be able to write short communicative responses reflecting mutual support and trust in friendship.
hatirla: To express preference: 'prefer + noun / V-ing to noun / V-ing' (e.g. I prefer rock to jazz).
With would rather: 'would rather + V1 than + V1' (e.g. I would rather listen to acoustic music than heavy metal).
Giving reasons: 'because', 'since', and 'as' are followed by a full subject-verb clause.
Making polite suggestions: 'Shall we ...?', 'Why don't we ...?', 'How about + V-ing ...?'.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki İngilizce tercih ve öneri kalıplarını dil bilgisi kurallarıyla eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: Used with nouns or gerunds (-ing) to contrast two choices
Used with base verbs (V1) without 'to' to show preference
Used with gerund (-ing) to offer an informal friendly suggestion
Used with base verb (V1) to propose a collaborative activity

sorular.soru: Görseldeki tercih tablosuna göre 'I would rather stay at home and listen to soft music ______ go to a noisy stadium concert.' cümlesindeki boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
Görseldeki öneri cümlesinde boş bırakılan kelimeyi yazınız: 'How about ______ (listen) to some jazz tonight?'
Görseldeki arkadaşlık ve tercih yapılarına göre yargılardan doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y işaretleyiniz.

ifadeler.metin: 'Prefer' takes the preposition 'to' when comparing two activities.
'Would rather' must always be followed by a gerund with -ing suffix.
Clauses introduced by 'since' and 'as' express logical reasons.
'Why don't you' is an aggressive expression that ruins friendship.

sorular.soru: Cümleleri 'Making Suggestions' (Öneri) ve 'Stating Preferences' (Tercih) kategorilerine göre tabloda işaretleyiniz.
satir_basliklari: Why don't we attend the acoustic festival together?
I would rather study in the quiet library than cafeteria
Shall we organize a picnic with our close classmates?
She prefers classical piano concerts to crowded pop shows

sorular.soru: Görseldeki iki arkadaş arasındaki hafta sonu planlama diyaloğunu mantıksal olarak 1'den 4'e kadar sıralayınız.
ogeler: Shall we buy tickets for the weekend rock music concert?
I would rather not because crowded venues make me anxious.
How about visiting an open-air art exhibition instead?
That sounds wonderful; I prefer quiet artistic events.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki arkadaşlık erdemleri panosuna göre, iyi bir dostun 'reliable' (güvenilir) olarak tanımlanmasının temel gerekçesi hangisidir?
secenekler: He always keeps his promises and backs his friends up.
He never shares his musical recordings or playlist with others.
He constantly criticizes his peers in public discussions.
He avoids spending any leisure time with his close circle.

sorular.soru: 'I prefer drinking tea ______ coffee.' cümlesinde iki seçenek arasına gelen edatı yazınız.
Görseldeki sebep bağlaçlarını cümle içi kullanım rolleriyle eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: Direct conjunction introducing the clear cause of an action
Conjunction explaining an already known background circumstance
Connector stating an evident causal factor within the clause
Transition word expressing the logical consequence or outcome

sorular.soru: Sosyal iletişim ve tercih ifade etme kurallarına dair yargılardan doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y işaretleyiniz.

ifadeler.metin: Using polite hedges when rejecting an invitation maintains strong friendship ties.
'I would rather to play chess' is a grammatically flawless English sentence.
True friendship is built on mutual honesty, loyalty, and deep empathy.
Stating preferences politely allows individuals to express their unique identity.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki arkadaşlık ipuçlarından yararlanarak bulmacayı çözünüz. Turuncu anahtar kutulardaki harflerle şifrelenmiş dostluk kavramını bulunuz.

sorular.soru: Explain why 'prefer' takes the preposition 'to' instead of 'than' in standard English grammar.
sorular.cevap: Because 'prefer' originates from Latin comparatives which require 'to'.
